items.title: Louis Gallaud Interview, 1960-03-18
items.q: when I was playing with Landry and Lewis

ctx.x: If you want to answer the phone, we can turn this off for a minute.

And for the music you hear now, you don't hear nothing now but this rock and roll, why the changes is not the same as them, you know what I mean? Of course, the changes that we would play music then was harder than now because some of the numbers now which you play is pretty hard for me, you know. Forget right now because Lewis, when I was playing with Landry and Lewis, they used to play some of them numbers that they played and there was some hard for me to catch in, you know what I mean? Because I used to hear…
That's what made me pick up and get a chance to play. That was the Bletchens you're talking about when Big Eye Lewis.
